description: This file defines classes and functions for handling tensor properties, weights, and grouping weights based on shared storage in a PyTorch model serialization context.

classes.name: TensorProperties
classes.description: Encapsulates properties of a PyTorch tensor, including storage pointers, size, shape, and whether it is a fake tensor.

classes.name: Weights
classes.description: A dictionary subclass mapping weight names to tuples of tensors and their properties, with methods to retrieve weights and properties.

methods.name: _end_ptr
methods.description: Calculates the end data pointer of a tensor based on its number of elements and element size.

methods.name: TensorProperties.__init__
methods.description: Initializes tensor properties such as fake status, contiguity, storage pointer, size, shape, stride, and offset.

methods.name: TensorProperties.is_complete
methods.description: Checks if the tensor completely overlaps with its underlying storage.

methods.name: Weights.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Weights object with a dictionary of weight data.

methods.name: Weights.get_weight
methods.description: Retrieves the tensor and properties for a given weight name.

methods.name: Weights.get_weight_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the properties of a specified weight.

methods.name: get_complete
methods.description: Finds a complete tensor within a group sharing the same storage, based on tensor properties.

methods.name: group_weights
methods.description: Groups weights that share the same underlying storage into sets.
